text: {"answerable": true, "answer": "DiffTRe keeps reusing the stored reference trajectory states for reweighting and updates until the effective sample size falls below a predefined threshold: as soon as Neff < N̄eff, a new reference trajectory is sampled using the current θ as the new reference parameters [W3168247670#007]. Equivalently, the new trajectory is generated when the statistical error from reweighting is no longer acceptably small [W3168247670#006]. The new trajectory starts from the last generated state S_N [W3168247670#007]."}
